trial_title: Adaptation and Validation of the Exercise Adherence Rating Scale of Knee Osteoarthritis Patients (GONEARS)
brief_summary:
The origin of knee osteoarthritis is multifactorial but the disease is strongly related to age. The pain and functional disability are the main reasons for consultation. Non-pharmaceutical treatment is always indicated.

eligibility_table.criterion: Painful Knee Osteoarthritis with presence of osteophytes on radiography
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has painful knee osteoarthritis and presents with osteophytes as indicated by the firm nodules and radiographic findings.

eligibility_table.criterion: At least 1 of the following 3 criteria's: adult >50 years old, morning stiffness <30 minutes, or in the pre-stage surgical (programmed knee prosthesis replacement).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 66 years old and experiences morning stiffness for less than 30 minutes, fulfilling one of the inclusion criteria.
